title: Topic 16
japanese_text: 近所に新しくできた中華料理の店は<u>本場</u>の味を楽しみたい人におすすめだ。<u>暖簾</u>をくぐると、中国まで来たのかと<u>錯覚する</u>くらい、店内が<u>特有</u>の香りに包まれている。また、料理は<u>とにかく</u>量が多い。
english_translation: I can recommend the new Chinese restaurant in my neighborhood if you want to enjoy authentic flavor. When you pass through the shop curtain, the restaurant is filled with a particular aroma that gives you the illusion you've traveled all the way to China. And the servings are generous, anyway.
